violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

violation_type.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

finding_variants.text: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.
The primary caregiver did not obtain 30 hours of training in the last full year of employment.
